question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and what surface should it cover?
rationale: The choice defines public API coverage, versioning, auth visibility, and whether plugin-provided routes or WebSocket RPC methods are represented, which cleanup automation should not choose from source layout alone.

options.title: Design Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers define format, served/static exposure, covered methods, auth rules, and versioning expectations.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Treat this as a release artifact for generated clients and defer runtime serving until auth and plugin-route exposure are settled.

options.title: Use Existing Protocol Schema
options.body: Close later only if maintainers explicitly decide the current TypeBox/draft-07 Gateway schema and RPC docs are the supported client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers define format, served/static exposure, covered methods, auth rules, and versioning expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent source-history signal across the current Gateway protocol, HTTP router, and public docs surfaces.
